Give me an overview of SRKR Engineering College Bhimavaram
Can you share background information about SRKR?
responses: Sagi Rama Krishna Raju (SRKR) Engineering College was established in 1980 by late Sri Sagi Rama Krishna Raju garu. Located in Chinna Amiram, Bhimavaram, West Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh, it is an autonomous institution affiliated to JNTU Kakinada (JNTUK), approved by AICTE, and accredited by NAAC with an 'A+' Grade.

patterns: How can I get admission into B.Tech at SRKR?
What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission?
What entrance exam is required for SRKR B.Tech?
How are Category A convenor seats allotted in SRKR?
Tell me about AP EAPCET admission in SRKR
How do I apply for B.Tech in SRKR College?
What is the management quota admission process for B.Tech?
responses: Admissions into B.Tech programmes at SRKR are conducted through two streams: 70% of seats are Category-A (Convenor Quota) filled via state counselling based on AP EAPCET (formerly EAMCET) rank; 30% of seats are Category-B (Management/NRI Quota) filled according to Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) guidelines. Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

responses: Yes, diploma holders and B.Sc graduates can gain direct lateral entry admission into the 2nd year (3rd semester) of B.Tech at SRKR via the AP ECET (Engineering Common Entrance Test) centralized counselling conducted by APSCHE.

responses: SRKR offers M.Tech in specialized engineering disciplines and Master of Computer Applications (MCA). M.Tech admissions are based on GATE / AP PGECET ranks, while MCA admissions are conducted through AP ICET counselling by APSCHE.

responses: SRKR offers undergraduate B.Tech programmes in: Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI&DS), Computer Science & Business Systems (CSBS), Computer Science & Design (CSD), Information Technology (IT), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mechanical Engineering (ME), and Civil Engineering (CE).

responses: As an autonomous college, SRKR follows an industry-aligned Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) curriculum modelled on AICTE guidelines and JNTUK regulations. It also offers Honors and Minor degree options in emerging technologies alongside regular degree courses.

responses: SRKR features an independent Autonomous Examination Cell. Assessment consists of Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) and Semester End Examinations (SEE). Results and grade cards (SGPA/CGPA on a 10-point scale) are published online on the official exam portal.

responses: Tuition fees at SRKR are fixed as per the Andhra Pradesh Higher Education Regulatory and Monitoring Commission (APHERMC) norms. Eligible Andhra Pradesh students admitted under Category-A convenor quota can avail government schemes such as Jagananna Vidya Deevena (JVD) for tuition fee reimbursement.
